scaled_2d_obstacle_recovery.description: Scaled nonlinear 2D obstacle recovery benchmark mirroring the paper's unicycle complex-constraint recovery protocol.
scaled_2d_obstacle_recovery.notes: Paper values are the reported unicycle g3 recovery accuracies from Sec. 4.2. The gym uses a CPU-feasible scaled 2D boundary-band analogue with the same safe/unsafe recovery objective and equal demonstration-budget constraint.

accuracy.description: Overall safe/unsafe classification accuracy on the scored boundary-band slice.

balanced_accuracy.description: Mean of safe-state and unsafe-state recall on the boundary-band split, which catches class-balance shortcuts.

near_boundary_balanced_accuracy.description: Balanced accuracy restricted to states closest to the inferred obstacle boundary, where recovery quality is hardest to fake with coarse rules.

safe_recall.description: Fraction of truly safe boundary-band states classified as safe, preserving the feasible-region recovery objective.

unsafe_recall.description: Fraction of truly unsafe boundary-band states classified as unsafe, preserving obstacle-detection quality.

n_demos.description: Number of requested demonstrations, penalizing methods that improve classification only by using a larger query budget.

scaled_2d_pinched_recovery.description: Second scaled nonlinear 2D obstacle recovery setting for testing whether the active-query advantage persists beyond one boundary family.
scaled_2d_pinched_recovery.notes: Paper values are the reported unicycle g1 recovery accuracies from Sec. 4.2. The gym uses another CPU-feasible radial nonlinear boundary with the same demonstration-budget constraint.

accuracy.description: Overall safe/unsafe classification accuracy on the scored boundary-band slice.

balanced_accuracy.description: Mean of safe-state and unsafe-state recall on the boundary-band split.

near_boundary_balanced_accuracy.description: Balanced accuracy restricted to states closest to the inferred obstacle boundary.

safe_recall.description: Fraction of truly safe boundary-band states classified as safe.

unsafe_recall.description: Fraction of truly unsafe boundary-band states classified as unsafe.
